opa. It is not necessary to start anti-reabsorptive treatment by age and absence of other risk factors.
opb. I would recommend orienting your diet to strengthen the consumption of products rich in calcium and phosphorus.
opc. You should start treatment with an anti-reabsorptive agent associated with calcium and vitamin D supplements.
opd. No pharmacological treatment should be instituted until the results of lumbar and femoral bone densitometry are available.
